answers.core: It involves the GDScript parser and other engine parts that can't easily be modified with an add-on.
answers.workaround: I work around this by using _get_property_list() and related properties and emulating an array by actually defining multiple properties as prefix_i where i is the index of the array. It's not... pretty, and it's definitely convoluted, so official support for this would definitely be appreciated.

title: Allow @exported Arrays to set property hints for its elements
